payload.title: Loaded deliver skill contradicts the integrator on merging into main and on order
payload.body: Cold read of the integrator session text (4 of 4 reads, /tmp/corrected-shards-cold-read/integrator-makes-whole/) passes every criterion, but opus flagged that the deliver skill still says integrate(unit) ≜ merge artifact(unit) into main, integrate ≺ assay admitted, and self decides the state moves. The integrator role says it never moves main, takes only achieved units, and plan state is the planner's. deliver-loop rewrites the skill and should remove the contradiction.
